learning_objective: 🎯 Let us become reading detectives by finding hidden clues and answering questions from longer stories!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When you get a new story passage, read it slowly two times. Highlight or underline the important names, places, and actions.
Sometimes the exact answer is not written in the story. If the story says 'Ravi wore a raincoat and held an umbrella', you can guess (infer) that it is raining outside!
Always answer the questions in full sentences. Use the words from the question to start your answer clearly.

fun_activity.title: 🕵️‍♂️ Be the Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Read a small paragraph from your English book. Cover it with your hand and tell your parent three main things that happened in the story!

quick_recap: ⭐ Read the passage twice to understand the story properly.
⭐ Making an inference means using clues from the text to guess the hidden meaning.
⭐ Always write your answers neatly in complete and full sentences.
